title: wg: ext-10 §4.6 app_components content unspecified
description: Suggestion. L585-587 a client "MUST understand and advertise the app_components component"; §5 (L913-916) defines it as the list of supported components but not whether it includes 0x0001 itself or every implemented component, which affects the check against the GroupContext required list. mimid lists only implemented components plus GREASE (decision mimid-1wgh.4.25). Fix: clarify.
notes:
Sent 2026-10-18: built-ins question folded into the #102 comment (issuecomment-6253376957)
Update 2026-10-18: mimid now reads §4.6 'MUST ... advertise the app_components component' as listing 0x0001 itself in the LeafNode app_components list (decision mimid-1wgh.4.25 reading B, 7ea4456). The wg question remains whether the list must also include every implemented component.
Reconciled 2026-10-18: PARTIAL: mls-extensions#102 comment asks only about built-ins in leaf lists; 'must every implemented component be listed' NOT asked.
